crawl_run_lease_check.name: crawl_run_lease_check
crawl_run_lease_check.value: ("crawl_run"."execution_status" = 'running' AND "crawl_run"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "crawl_run"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("crawl_run"."execution_status" <> 'running' AND "crawl_run"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "crawl_run"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

site_url_evidence_check.name: site_url_evidence_check
site_url_evidence_check.value: ("site_url"."status"='active' AND "site_url"."missing_confirmations"=0 AND "site_url"."first_missing_run_id" IS NULL AND "site_url"."first_missing_observed_at" IS NULL AND "site_url"."last_missing_run_id" IS NULL AND "site_url"."removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("site_url"."status"='pending_removed' AND "site_url"."missing_confirmations"=1 AND "site_url"."first_missing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."first_missing_observed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."last_missing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("site_url"."status"='removed' AND "site_url"."missing_confirmations"=2 AND "site_url"."first_missing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."first_missing_observed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."last_missing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "site_url"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
